lines.text: The LORD will restore pure lips, and His scattered worshipers beyond the rivers of Cush will bring offerings.
The LORD will remove those who rejoice in their wealth and leave within His people a meek and humble people.
The remnant will speak no lies, and will feed and lie down with no one to make them tremble.
Daughter of Zion is told to sing because the LORD has taken away her land and turned back her enemy.
The LORD will rejoice over His people with singing, save the lame, and restore their captives before their very eyes.
